title: CBDT Notifies Cost Inflation Index (CII) at 384 for FY 2026-27
summary: Increases Cost Inflation Index by 2.3% for long-term capital gains tax calculations.

items: CII Index Value: Notified at 384 for FY 2026-27 (up from 376 in FY 2025-26).
